purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public land-record routes, bounded anonymous access review, and evidence limits.
assessment: The official KP Board of Revenue CLRMIS landing page is public but directs users to account creation, NADRA biometric verification, login, and ownership search using personal identity fields.
